def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    # find template: cells of colors other than the marker color... marker color = most frequent non-bg
    others.sort(key=lambda v:-cnt[v])
    marker=others[0]
    tcells=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,marker)]
    rs=[r for r,c,v in tcells]; cs=[c for r,c,v in tcells]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    tmpl=sorted(tcells)
    # relative offsets from template anchor (min r,min c)

    hr=max(r for r,c,v in rel)-min(r for r,c,v in rel); wc=max(c for r,c,v in rel)-min(c for r,c,v in rel)
    R=[[bg]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    # keep template in place
    for r,c,v in tcells: R[r][c]=v
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    for r,c in cells(grid,marker):
        # stamp centered: template bbox center at (r,c)
        cr=(min(rr for rr,cc,v in rel)+max(rr for rr,cc,v in rel))//2
        cc=(min(x for rr,x,v in rel)+max(x for rr,x,v in rel))//2
        for dr,dc,v in rel:
